response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong general software engineering abilities and excellent communication skills, they critically lack the mandatory technical requirements for this role. Most significantly, they have only 6 months of documented C++ experience (2014-2015), falling far short of the required 5-10 years. There is no evidence of Windows platform development, and their SQL knowledge lacks specificity to SQL Server or Oracle. Although they have limited exposure to capital markets through a brief role at RIDE Capital, there is no demonstrated expertise in fixed income or fixed income derivatives. Recent professional focus has been web development and full-stack engineering with TypeScript and Node.js, not the C++ and capital markets systems expertise this position requires.
strengths: Strong general software development background with 20 years of experience across multiple programming languages, platforms, and technical domains
Excellent communication and knowledge-sharing abilities demonstrated through workshops, technical talks, and open-source contributions; clear writing and presentation skills
Demonstrated CI/CD and DevOps expertise with hands-on experience setting up CI servers, deployment pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure automation
concerns: Only 6 months of C++ experience documented (2014-2015), vastly insufficient for the mandatory 5-10 years of professional C++ development required for this role
No evidence of Windows platform development experience; entire recent career focused on web-based systems and Linux environments, not desktop or financial systems

Lacks demonstrated expertise in fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets systems; financial services exposure limited to a 13-month role at an investment startup with no indication of fixed income specialization

key_factors.factor: Capital Markets / Fixed Income Domain Knowledge
